title: Glowing laptop
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='screenGlow' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#9ff3ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#4fd8ff'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bgGlow' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#1b6fa8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#0e4a73'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- glow aura behind laptop -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='38' ry='30' fill='#3fc9ff' opacity='0.18'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='28' ry='22' fill='#7fe6ff' opacity='0.15'/>

  <!-- laptop lid -->
  <rect x='22' y='18' width='56' height='40' rx='4' fill='#c9d4e0'/>
  <rect x='22' y='18' width='56' height='40' rx='4' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.35'/>

  <!-- screen bezel -->
  <rect x='26' y='22' width='48' height='32' rx='2' fill='#3a4a5c'/>

  <!-- glowing screen -->
  <rect x='28' y='24' width='44' height='28' rx='1' fill='url(#bgGlow)'/>

  <!-- screen content: bright window -->
  <rect x='31' y='27' width='24' height='16' rx='1.5' fill='url(#screenGlow)'/>
  <rect x='31' y='27' width='24' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#e8fdff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <rect x='33' y='34' width='14' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <rect x='33' y='38' width='18' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- small glowing icon on screen -->
  <circle cx='63' cy='32' r='4' fill='#c9ff8a' opacity='0.9'/>
  <rect x='59' y='38' width='8' height='2' rx='1' fill='#c9ff8a' opacity='0.7'/>
  <rect x='59' y='42' width='6' height='2' rx='1' fill='#c9ff8a' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- light spill from screen onto lid edges -->
  <rect x='22' y='18' width='56' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#8ff0ff' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- laptop base -->
  <path d='M18 58 L82 58 L86 66 L14 66 Z' fill='#dfe8f2'/>
  <path d='M18 58 L82 58 L82 60.5 L18 60.5 Z' fill='#aebfd0'/>

  <!-- keyboard hint -->
  <rect x='30' y='61.5' width='40' height='3' rx='1' fill='#8496a8'/>
  <rect x='44' y='61.5' width='12' height='3' rx='1' fill='#5f7displaced'/>

  <!-- trackpad / notch -->
  <rect x='44' y='66' width='12' height='2' rx='1' fill='#b7c6d6'/>
</svg>
